corrected_prompt:
Premium studio claymation scene - everything sculpted from matte plasticine with refined intentional craftsmanship: subtle tool marks, controlled texture, soft rounded geometry, slight subsurface warmth, macro lens feel with shallow depth of field, soft diffused studio lighting with a gentle rim glow, the scene filling the entire frame with the camera inside the miniature clay world. Vertical 9:16 frame. Palette: warm cream #F3E9D8 backdrop and floor, terracotta #C8553D accents, sage #8FA98B, deep ink #2B2A33 for letters on screens, heart red #D64545.

References: none attached (text to image).

Subject and pose: one single modern clay smartphone, a professional clay imitation of a black-glass phone with a rounded terracotta #C8553D clay case rim, no logo, no buttons visible. It stands upright on its bottom edge in the centre of the frame, occupying the area from 18% to 82% of the frame width and from 30% to 86% of the frame height (64% of the width, 56% of the height), screen lit and facing the camera, leaning back about 5 degrees against nothing.

Hands: no hands visible.

Action as contact points: the phone's bottom edge rests on the cream clay floor; about a dozen hearts rest on the floor and against the phone's lower edge; no heart touches the screen.

Props with content: The phone screen shows a clay booking page: a cream band across the top of the screen holding the words "BOOK A CALL" in heavy bold deep ink #2B2A33 capital letters spanning the screen width; under it a big calendar grid of 3 rows by 5 columns of plain cream clay squares with thin ink outlines, every square empty: no digits, no names, no marks. At the phone's foot, a loose pile of about a dozen plump thumb-pressed clay hearts in heart red #D64545, spread from 15% to 85% of the width at 82% to 92% of the height.

Text: exactly "BOOK A CALL", capital letters, on the cream band at the top of the phone screen, at 36% to 42% of the frame height and 24% to 76% of the frame width, centred; nothing covers any letter. No other text anywhere.

Setting and background: a soft cream clay floor meeting a plain cream clay backdrop, softly out of focus; no signs, frames, posters or other screens. The top 30% of the frame is plain empty cream backdrop.

Camera: straight on at screen height, the camera inside the miniature clay world, macro lens feel, shallow depth of field, vertical 9:16; top 30% calm and empty, bottom 15% calm (no text and no extra objects; only the base of the heart pile may reach into it), main subject inside 10% to 90% of the frame width; the phone is the one big subject.

Continuity: first frame of the reel; nothing carried over.

Negatives: no logo, wordmark, real app name or app icon anywhere; no digits or numbers anywhere; no words other than the quoted ones; nothing at all in the top 30% of the frame except the plain cream backdrop; no faces; no set edges, workbench or room outside the clay world; no glossy CGI look.

Everything in frame is real professionally sculpted matte plasticine, photographed - refined sculpting marks, real cast shadows, soft studio lighting, the clay scene filling the entire frame.
